goal: Implement the native direct-provider generation lifecycle foundation that connects chat turns to LLM profile selection, mockable provider runtimes, pending/streaming reply state, stale-token protection, and explicit no-model UX.
non_goals: Do not call real LLM providers from automated tests or device smoke.
Do not require Python runtime for Android chat generation.
Do not implement WorkManager background jobs or notifications; those belong to NATIVE-P3-001 and NATIVE-P3-002.
Do not implement full source citation/context injection; that belongs to NATIVE-P5-007.
Do not implement Phase 4 import/export protocols.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness.
acceptance_criteria: A native generation request model captures sessionId, message text, selected LLM profile metadata, provider kind, model, baseUrl, capability flags, quote/image-draft context where applicable, and a generation token.
A direct-provider runtime abstraction exists for OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible strategies without forcing real network calls in tests.
A deterministic fake provider runtime can return success, streaming chunks, failure, timeout-like errors, and stale-token scenarios.

Chat generation lifecycle supports no-model configured state, pending reply state, success reply persistence, failure message/diagnostic state, cancellation or stale-token rejection, and regenerate entry foundation.
Assistant replies are persisted as assistant messages only when the generation token still belongs to the active session/request.
Image draft or vision input checks respect provider capability flags and degrade gracefully when unsupported.

Automated tests cover no-profile/no-model UX, generation request construction, fake streaming parsing/aggregation, stale-token rejection, provider failure mapping, assistant message persistence, and no real provider calls.
Settings/profile foundation from NATIVE-P2-004 is consumed through repository/model boundaries rather than duplicated logic.
Chat UI exposes clear pending/no-model/failure states without hiding the existing local composer and timeline behavior.
Legacy coverage registry is updated conservatively for LEG-016, LEG-018, and LEG-042.
verification_expectations: Follow TDD: add failing tests before production implementation for generation request model, fake runtime, streaming aggregation, no-model state, stale-token rejection, provider failure mapping, and chat UI state.
Run focused core llm, core data, feature chat, and app JVM tests.
Run native project test, lint, and app assembleDebug.
Run connected instrumentation only if the implementation touches Room DAO behavior requiring device validation.
Install preview debug APK on the connected device and capture no-model/pending/mock-generation smoke evidence when feasible.
Use app pid/package-specific logcat filtering to avoid global AndroidRuntime false positives.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json and rebuild codegraph.
notes: Existing PRD/ARCH/TODO and prior user approval are the design basis for this task.
P2-005 should connect P2-003 chat and P2-004 LLM profile foundation without adding background jobs yet.
If a production HTTP client dependency is needed, treat it as a dependency decision and avoid adding a major dependency without explicit user approval.
This task may implement provider protocol contracts and fake/direct runtime boundaries before live network validation.
